summary: PowerShell to import the client certificate into LocalMachine\TrustedPeople, and for self-signed or untrusted-CA certs, also import the CA (or the cert itself) into LocalMachine\Root.
questions: Which certificate store does the WinRM client cert go in?
How do I import a PEM certificate into TrustedPeople with PowerShell?
Do I need to add my self-signed cert to the trusted root store?

answer_card.title: Importing the client certificate on Windows
answer_card.answer_md:
Import into `LocalMachine\TrustedPeople`:

```powershell
$cert = [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2]::new("cert.pem")
$store = Get-Item -LiteralPath Cert:\LocalMachine\TrustedPeople
$store.Open('ReadWrite'); $store.Add($cert); $store.Dispose()
```

If it's self-signed or from an untrusted CA, also add it (or the issuing CA in production) to `Cert:\LocalMachine\Root` the same way.
